name: usehako
description: Hako CLI and local MCP server: discover and inspect agent tools for free; paid runs are paid with your PayBox wallet.

scripts.build:
tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/hako.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node -e "require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/hako.mjs', 0o755)"
